system.description:
Add-On (Passive): Add-Ons are made to an item with the Clothes Set property. They take no item slot: denote them on the Clothing Set to which they are added.

Goldwing (Passive): Prerequisite: Sandals. When you purchase this, choose a pair of Sandals to which they apply. When wearing those Sandals, increase your base move speed by 5ft.

No Item Slot · 200gc · Clothing Add-Ons, rulebook p.199
